objective.text: Constrain user-influenced outbound destinations and redirects rather than treating URL syntax validation as SSRF protection.

difficulty.rationale: Combine application destination selection with connection-time and redirect constraints.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: The feature only needs a known partner export service; arbitrary internet fetches are not a requirement.

stem: A proposed endpoint passes a user-submitted URL through the url validation rule and then to Http::get. Which design addresses the missing destination trust boundary?

options.text: Validate only the initial hostname, then follow redirects without applying the destination policy again.
options.rationale: An allowed initial endpoint can redirect to a destination outside the permitted boundary.
options.misconception: An allowed initial endpoint can redirect to a destination outside the permitted boundary.

options.text: Accept any syntactically valid HTTPS URL and rely on TLS to block internal destinations.
options.rationale: TLS authenticates a connection’s peer; it does not prove that destination is allowed for this feature.
options.misconception: TLS authenticates a connection’s peer; it does not prove that destination is allowed for this feature.

options.text: Reject the literal string localhost but allow all other valid hostnames and automatic redirects.
options.rationale: Alternate addresses, DNS resolution and redirects can still reach forbidden destinations.
options.misconception: Alternate addresses, DNS resolution and redirects can still reach forbidden destinations.

options.text: Build the partner request from trusted configuration and constrain actual connections and redirects.
options.rationale: URL syntax alone does not establish an allowed destination. Use validated business input, an explicit destination policy, connection-time network controls and redirects that cannot escape the policy.

explanation.summary: URL syntax alone does not establish an allowed destination. Use validated business input, an explicit destination policy, connection-time network controls and redirects that cannot escape the policy.
